answer: A saffron trading agent should earn a reputation score from fulfilled orders, with each buyer allocating a fixed review budget across all sellers. Splitting one seller into many names then spreads the same budget instead of creating a ripple of free trust. Over a rolling horizon, reviews count only after delivery disputes close. An attacker must finance real purchases and wait for settlement to raise many identities. Colluding buyers can still recycle funds, so circular trade detection helps, though it may also flag legitimate wholesalers.
